simple.meaning: צָלַל (tsâlal) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to tinkle , i.e. rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 4 times in 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, Jeremiah, Habakkuk, beginning at 1 Samuel 3:11. The surrounding contexts include kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָלַל (H6750) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צָלַל (tsâlal) / H6750 is traced through 1 Samuel 3:11, 2 Kings 21:12, Jeremiah 19:3, Habakkuk 3:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to tinkle , i.e. rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear)
definitions.full: H6750. tsalal I. [ צָלַל ] verb tingle, quiver (Late Hebrew צִלְצֵל whirr (rare); Arabic , ; צְלַל ᵑ7 ; Syriac ); — Perfect 3plural צָֽלְלוּ Hab 3:16 ; Imperfect 3feminine plural תְּצִלֶּינָה 1Sam 3:11 , תִּצַּלְנָה (Ges § 67g ) 2Kin 21:12 ; Jer 19:3 ; — tingle , of ears, at horrid sound 1Sam 3:11 ; 2Kin 21:12 ; Jer 19:3 (all of dreadful news); of lips, quiver in terror Hab 3:16 .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of vibration);

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
therefore Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.
Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.
I heard, and my body trembled.
